title: Personal Moneta runtime connection
description: Portable profile generated once by init. Organization targets are explicit local-origin matching rules, including subgroups and future repositories. They authorize no organization discovery, repository listing, network request, source scan or graph read by hooks. Checkouts are derived privately on each machine, never stored here.

repository-url.description: Personal memory repository URL without passwords or HTTP credentials. HTTPS, SSH URL and git@host:path forms are supported.

namespace.description: Explicit group path. Matches only repositories beneath this complete namespace boundary on the exact host, including subgroups.

url.description: Exact repository URL without passwords or HTTP credentials.
